pr_title: Fix replays showing incorrect star difficulty on load
pr_body:
- Closes #18980 

Replays update mods bindable with score mods on `OnEntering`, which can happen after `BeatmapMetadataDisplay` displays the current (no score mods) star rating.

Alternative fix would be to update the mods bindable much earlier (at BDL or load complete), but going with a more local fix for now.

issue_context.title: Mods in song select affect star rating when watching replays
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/18975
Originally posted by **Flamiii** July 2, 2022 Map used: https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/1456709#osu/2993974 When entering gameplay or watching a replay, there's a screen that appears which shows which mods are selected and what the star rating of the map with those mods is. The star rating is correct when you're playing yourself, but if you try to watch a replay, the star rating of the map will show up with the mods that you currently have selected in song select, rather than the ones in the actual replay you're watching. For example, this is what trying to watch a HDDT replay on Kano - Stella-rium (Asterisk MAKINA Remix) [Starlight] looks like when I have no mods selected in song select: ![osu_2022-07-01_18-37-48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74088315/176977866-9e2ea029-4eaf-45e4-a738-c9458ed8b4d1.png) If I have EZHT currently selected in song select and then try to watch the HDDT replay: ![osu_2022-07-01_18-41-49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74088315/176977971-74b4aa50-c766-415f-8824-3fc986cbc84a.png) What it should look like regardless of the mods I have selected in song select (the map with HDDT is actually 8.99*): ![osu_2022-07-01_18-43-00](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74088315/176978000-438a9499-af88-4dc1-9a0c-ef27e3cb34ca.png)

review_comments: Is there much reason to keep the above `Show` logic rather than use `BindValueChanged(...,true)`? Second is preferable I think.

Haven't done that because the initial logic above shows star rating display immediately, but if the calculation takes longer, it fades in smoothly once it's ready instead. Could merge together and use `d.NewValue == d.OldValue` to decide the transition, but not sure that reads better.
okay, let's go with it then. didn't see the initial `Alpha=0`.
